# cato_bulk_split_tunnel_move_rule (Resource)

Orders Split Tunnel sections and rules and publishes the policy revision. Sections are ordered by `section_index`; rules by `index_in_section` within their `section_name`. This resource is not importable; it is created on the first apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Use the names of an existing policy section and rule.
resource "cato_bulk_split_tunnel_move_rule" "policy_order" {
  section_data = {
    "Office" = { section_index = 1 }
  }
  rule_data = {
    "Allow HTTPS" = { index_in_section = 1, section_name = "Office" }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `rule_data` (Attributes Map) Map of rule name to its ordering data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule_data))
- `section_data` (Attributes Map) Map of section name to its ordering data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--section_data))

<a id="nestedatt--rule_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_data`

Required:

- `index_in_section` (Number) 1-based position of the rule within its section.
- `section_name` (String) Name of the section the rule is ordered within.


<a id="nestedatt--section_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `section_data`

Required:

- `section_index` (Number) 1-based position of the section in the policy.
